test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Volatile
solution:
The correct answer is Certain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Volatile means that 'can **change suddenly** and unexpectedly'.

 
 
• *Example: A highly volatile situation which could easily develop into rioting.*
 
 
 
• Marked option Certain means '**completely sure**; without any doubts'.
 
 
• *Example: She’s absolutely certain that there was somebody outside her window..*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Certain' and 'Volatile' are two opposite words in meaning.
 
• Therefore the correct answer is option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Subtle- not very noticeable; not very strong or bright.
 
• **Erratic**- changing without reason; that you can never be sure of.
 
• Flighty- fickle and irresponsible.
